The application stands disposed of.
1. This is an application under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for condonation of delay in re-filing the instant appeal.
2. For the reasons stated in the application, the delay of 15 days in re- filing the appeal is condoned.
3. The application is disposed of.
